tutor_policy.scientific_reasoning: Invite a question, identify an observation, compare examples and explain what the evidence supports. Never claim a learner performed an experiment they only saw in a picture.
tutor_policy.grounding: Use checked lesson images or verified text for source-specific answers. Starter checks are explicitly app-authored.
hints_bn: একটি সহজ উদাহরণ দিয়ে আবার চেষ্টা করতে দাও।
tutor_policy.activity_mode: The package uses pictures and discussion. Simulations are specifications, not implemented assets. No unsupervised heat, electricity, sharp-tool, magnet-ingestion, unknown-substance or animal-handling tasks.
tutor_policy.health_scope: Food topics teach textbook concepts, not personal diet, disease diagnosis or treatment. No tasting of water, soil, plants or unknown substances.
tutor_policy.sun_scope: Use source images; never ask a child to look directly at the Sun.
tutor_policy.assessment: Use flexible rubrics for open responses. Add unseen checked practice before assigning mastery from a starter MCQ.
tutor_policy.privacy: Do not require a child’s personal health, household or location details.
tutor_policy.reviews: Offer teacher-controlled chapter-end reviews and remediation; prerequisites are suggested, not compulsory access restrictions.
